subject: M5 Structures from the 1,212 official NBT templates
description: Major unlock measured from the official jar: 1,212 structure .nbt templates DO ship in client-26.2.jar (3.7 MB uncompressed, 16 families): village 483, trial_chambers 191, bastion 167, trail_ruins 84, woodland_mansion 73, ancient_city 58, underwater_ruin 48, shipwreck 20, end_city 20, fossil 16, ruined_portal 13, pillager_outpost 11, spring 10, igloo 3. Plus 34 worldgen/structure defs, 20 structure_set, 188 template_pool, 40 processor_list. Today src/structures.ts is hand-built box/cylinder procedural junk with one hardcoded village anchor, which is a big part of why the world reads as cheap. Work: extract the .nbt templates into the served asset tree, write an NBT reader (lists/compound/IntArray/palette), map template block states to our state ids, apply structure integrity/bounding boxes, jigsaw pool placement with the official template_pool + structure_weight rules, a subset of processors (attachment, jig-saw, gravity, block_ignore, rule), and per-biome village types (plains/snowy/desert/savanna/taiga) with paths and streets. Verify by walking into a real village and comparing the silhouette against vanilla screenshots.
